tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand ground. The page, icon and header background in light use; the mark and text colour in reversed (dark) use.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Mark, wordmark and text on paper; the ground in dark use. Contrast on paper 16:1.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: The single accent: the G crossbar, the BLANCO line and one ring arc. Marks and type of 24px or larger only (3.6:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on ink); never body copy. At most 10% of any layout.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions. 6:1 on paper and 7.6:1 on ink.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Text, mark and rules on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and tints one step off surface. Text on it uses on-surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, ruler ticks and ring strokes at 2px. Decorative only; never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: on-vermilion
tokens.usage: Text on a vermilion fill, in both themes (4.6:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cover and hero name, two lines. Bold, sentence case.

styles.name: wordmark-first
styles.usage: First line of the typographic wordmark, capitals, ink.

styles.name: wordmark-second
styles.usage: Second line of the wordmark, capitals, Regular, vermilion.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every dimension comes from one unit.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small capitals labels, tracked, ink or stone.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks; equals the mark stroke at 1u = 1px.

tokens.name: grid-unit
tokens.usage: The layout unit. 4096×2304 is 64×36 grid-units; every header measure is a multiple.

tokens.name: grid-2
tokens.usage: Margins and the gap between mark and wordmark.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Large blocks and pattern pitch (4 grid-units).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: panels, buttons, blocks, images are square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Dots and the central ring disc only.

ratio.note: Proportion used for ring radii and splits.

tokens.name: phi
tokens.usage: Ring radius n = 320px × phi^n; asymmetric splits at 1/phi.
